card.title: Plant Manager - Pallet Manufacturing
card.description:
Overview:

As a **Plant Manager**, you’ll get to work alongside a General Manager to manage all plant operations and deliver superior customer satisfaction! You’ll be able to drive results and exceed our customer’s expectations in the areas of safety, service, quality, and cost by achieving the highest of standards. We’re looking for the individual who finds motivation in motivating others to achieve lofty goals.

What You'll Do:

* Manage the work of all production employees oversees production and shipping schedules based on availability of raw and finished goods
* Provide hands-on leadership as a working manager, responsible for mentoring and coaching all employees and managing employee relations issues
* Support plant administration to ensure compliance to established policies
* Assist with the entire new hire process with dedicated Recruiter and Onboarding Team in HR, and make all employment decisions within the plant
* Consult with the General Manager for the cost and yield performance of the Plant
* Support and implement cost control initiatives and process control within the Plant
* Continually review operations activities, including local transportation activities to maintain compliance with all Federal, State and local laws (OSHA, DOL, DOJ, EPA, FD)
* Drive Safety improvements across the Plant
* Ensure the consistent execution of all SOPs throughout the Plant and in accordance with the PMS Commercial Organization, Global Supply Chain
* Deliver best operational practices and cost efficiencies across the Plant while maintaining critical quality and raw material utilization standards that are necessary to maintain customer satisfaction and Plant profitability
* Implement and manage Lean opportunities to effectively eliminate waste
* Provide leadership to Plant staff to effectively recruit, train, develop, evaluate, motivate, delegate and monitor their activities
* Drive efficiencies in asset utilization through proper transportation scheduling, dispatch, & driver management while meeting customer expectations

What You'll Need:

* Bachelor’s Degree in Operations/Supply Chain or related field
* Six Sigma/Lean certification preferred
* 5+ years of experience in a supervisory role in an engineering or manufacturing environment
* Familiarity with private fleet management/transportation is preferred
* Demonstrated success in motivating and delivering strong employee relations with non-exempt employees
* Experience managing safety performance and programs

What We Offer:

* Competitive Pay, Holiday Pay, and Daily Pay – Access to your earned wages before payday!
* Referral Bonuses
* Long-Term Career Advancement
* Paid Time Off
* Medical, Dental, Vision, Basic Life, AD&D, and Short-Term & Long-Term Disability insurance for Eligible Full Time Employees
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Great Team Environment

What It's Like:

48forty Solutions is the largest pallet management services company in North America! We provide end-to-end pallet solutions, from supply to retrieval, on-site services, reverse logistics, and packaging materials. We are truly Pallet Management Made Simple, our workforce is the heart and soul of our business, and we’re looking for our next **Plant Manager** to join our team!

Here's a video to see what it's like:

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions.

* Ability to work in extreme conditions to include, but not limited to, elements, heat, cold, and air particulate
* Repetitively lift up to 50-75 pounds and adjust body position to bend, stoop, walk, turn, pivot, and stand for entire shifts of varying lengths in time
* The noise level in the work environment is dependent on location.
* Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) is required (eye protection, ear protection is mandatory at several locations, safety shoes)
* Specific vision abilities required by this job include, close vision, distance vision and color vision.

**48forty Solutions** is an equal opportunity employer.

Pay Range: USD $85,000.00 - USD $95,000.00 /Yr.

Location:
Niles, IL, US, 60714

Req ID: 41695

Segment: Operations

Rich’s, also known as Rich Products Corporation, is a family-owned food company dedicated to inspiring possibilities. From cakes and icings to pizza, appetizers and specialty toppings, our products are used in homes, restaurants and bakeries around the world. Beyond great food, our customers also gain insights to help them stay competitive, no matter their size. Our portfolio includes creative solutions geared at helping food industry professionals compete in foodservice, retail, in-store bakery, deli, and prepared foods, among others. With more than 13,500 associates working globally in 100 countries and annual sales of $5.9 billion, Rich’s is a global leader with a focus on everything that family makes possible. Rich’s®—Infinite Possibilities. One Family.

**Purpose Statement**
---------------------

The Plant Manager's responsibility is to provide leadership to all departments for overall vision and direction of the plant by way of guidance, direction, encouragement, training and development. Also developing and coaching managers and supervisors to excel to the peak of their performance levels. In addition to directing all managerial personnel to manage their departments and functional areas to meet the manufacturing plant’s operational and financial objectives while supporting the values, mission, vision, and priorities of Rich Products Corporation.

**Key Accountabilities and Outcomes**
-------------------------------------

* Full responsibility for the complete operation of the manufacturing facility.
* Ensures safe, efficient operation of the plant within the guidelines established by Rich Products and all governmental laws and regulations to include all food safety programs and auditing processes.
* Monitors production, inventory, safety, human resources, quality assurance, maintenance and sanitation programs.
* Plans capital projects, long range strategic planning, and succession planning.
* Promotes Lean Manufacturing concepts and leads the plant with Rich Products vision; is open to, and promotes change to continually improve and enhance the facility and workforce to stay ahead of the competition.
* Ensures ethical behavior in all aspects of managing the facility and its material and human resources.
* Responsibility for manufacturing facility’s Capital and operating budgets.
* Responsible for associate and leadership development, developing team skills, and creating a culture of engagement and continuous improvement.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Experience**
-------------------------------------

* Bachelors Degree in Business Management, Food Science, Engineering, Science or similar academic disciplines.
* 5-10 Years Experience at the Plant Management Position and 5-10 years in a supervisory and or management position with progressively more responsible positions.
* Knowledge of Food Safety, Associate Safety Programs/Systems HAACP, GMPs etc. Sanitation and Plant Maintenance and Continuous Improvement such as Lean Manufacturing and Total Productive Manufacturinng (TPM) would be definite assets.
* A Master’s in Business Administration is preferred but not required.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills and cultural sensitivity required. Foreign Language skills as it relates to the facility’s demographics are a plus.
* Ability to manage a diverse staff of managerial personnel.
* Experience with self-directed teams/skill-based pay.

 #Womenmfg

**Annual Range/Hourly Rate**

$162,450.00 - $270,750.00

------------------------------------

As a family-owned company, caring for our associates—their whole selves—is a top priority. That’s why we provide benefits and tools to help our people balance the integration of work and life:

* Competitive compensation
* Health & financial benefits
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Family planning support
* Flexible work policy
* Associate resource groups
* Volunteering & community impact opportunities
* Holiday gatherings

It’s all part of how we support our family of associates. ***Because in the company of family, all things are possible.***

card.title: Plant General Manager
card.description:
Job Description:

Location: Fairfield, OH

Reports To: North American Cluster Leader, SP MDC

**About Schneider Electric**

Schneider Electric is leading the digital transformation of energy management and automation. Our mission is to be your digital partner for Sustainability and Efficiency. We drive innovation in everything we do and empower our employees to make bold decisions.

**Position Summary**

The Manufacturing Plant General Manager will lead the Ohio Modular Data Center facilities (two manufacturing plants and one warehouse), overseeing all aspects of plant & warehouse operations, including production, logistics, engineering, quality, safety, and continuous improvement. This role is critical in driving operational excellence, employee development, and customer satisfaction in a fast-paced, engineer-to-order and design build environment. This includes planning, forecasting, executing, and testing Modular Data Centers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Leadership & Strategy**

* Define and execute plant strategies aligned with Schneider Electric’s global goals.
* Lead cross-functional teams to deliver on scope, schedule, cost, and quality.
* Champion Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma initiatives.
* Foster a culture of safety, sustainability, and continuous improvement.

**Operations Management**

* Oversee daily operations, including production, materials management, engineering, and maintenance.
* Manage plant KPIs, including safety, quality, on-time delivery, productivity, and cost.
* Validate and execute the Master Production Plan and ensure efficient resource allocation.
* Drive digital transformation and smart manufacturing initiatives using EcoStruxure technologies.

**People & Culture**

* Develop and mentor plant personnel, promoting career growth and engagement.
* Collaborate with HR to implement people management strategies and skills development.
* Promote a positive, inclusive, and high-performance culture.

**Customer & Compliance**

* Ensure strong communication with internal and external customers.
* Maintain compliance with government regulations and Schneider Electric policies.
* Lead efforts to improve customer satisfaction through technical and operational excellence.

(External) English Qualifications:

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, or Industrial Management.
* Strong experience in manufacturing or industrial operations.
* Proven track record in managing engineer-to-order or design-build environments.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, supply chain, and logistics.
* Certified in Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma; PMP certification is a plus.
* Experience with SAP/ERP systems
* Excellent communication, leadership, decision-making, and conflict resolution skills.

**What’s** **in It for You**

* Competitive compensation and benefits package.
* Flexible work arrangements and paid family leave.
* 401(k) with company match.
* Opportunities for career advancement and mobility.
* Be part of a company committed to sustainability and innovation.

Local Benefits (English):

At Schneider, we believe that every employee is a talent who deserves equal opportunities. This means you matter. Every individual needs to feel valued, supported, and treated fairly to do their best work.

Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: “We see you. We value you”. It’s more than just pay and benefits- it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed for you to perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential to shine as an impact maker.

For this U.S. based position, the expected pay range is USD 208,000 - USD 312,000 per year. This pay range includes base pay and short-term incentives. The compensation range for this full-time position applies to candidates located within the United States. Our pay ranges are determined by reviewing roles of similar responsibility and level. Within the pay range, individual pay is determined by several factors including performance, knowledge, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

**Schneider Electric is there when it matters most to you**

Our Total Rewards package outlines all the benefits and support you’ll enjoy as part of the Schneider Electric team:

**Care for Yourself and Your Family.** We ensure you feel secure with benefits that help you and your family thrive: medical (with member reward points), dental, vision, and basic life insurance, Benefit Bucks (credits to apply towards your benefits), flexible work arrangements, paid family leaves, well-being programs, 12 holidays per year, 20 days of paid time off per year (pro-rated in the first year of employment based on start date).

**Invest and Plan Your Future.** We help you plan and invest for the future with competitive pay and programs: your base salary, short-term incentives or sales incentives, opportunities to own company shares (eligibility depends on start date), and 401(k) + match.

**Grow Your Skills and Career.** We commit to helping you grow with ongoing performance and development conversations, Senior Talent Program, global career opportunities, access to our Schneider Career Hub for new positions, projects, and mentors, and learning platforms like Coursera to equip you with the skills for today and tomorrow.

**Team Up in the Workplace.** We encourage teaming up through project opportunities on the Schneider Career Hub, smart ways to collaborate, celebrating contributions via a recognition program (including service anniversary), sharing your voice in our engagement survey, and fostering an inclusive, caring workplace.

**Support Your Community.** We make a difference in your community with volunteer leave, programs through the Schneider Electric Foundation, initiatives that support youth education, and military leave benefits.

When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. We believe that our IMPACT values – Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork – starts with us.

IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.

We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.

Become an IMPACT Maker with Schneider Electric – apply today!

We mirror the diversity of the communities in which we operate, and ‘inclusion’ is one of our core values. We believe our differences make us stronger as a company and as individuals and we are committed to championing inclusivity in everything we do.*

*At Schneider Electric, we uphold the highest standards of ethics and compliance, and we believe that trust is a foundational value. Our Trust Charter is our Code of Conduct and demonstrates our commitment to ethics, safety, sustainability, quality and cybersecurity, underpinning every aspect of our business and our willingness to behave and respond respectfully and in good faith to all our stakeholders. You can find out more about our Trust Charter* *here*

card.description:
Since 2018, Elevate Aircraft Seating has been enhancing the passenger experience through innovative aircraft seat design and manufacturing. With locations in California, Washington, and Germany we are guided by creativity, collaboration, and a shared commitment to quality.

We are looking for a skilled Senior Customer Quality Manager to join our team in Charleston, South Carolina. This is an on-site position based in Charleston, South Carolina. We value teamwork, inclusivity, and continuous professional development, and we offer competitive benefits along with opportunities for growth.

**Export Control Requirements:**

**This position must meet U.S. export control compliance requirements. To meet U.S. export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. §120.62 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Senior Manager of Customer Quality serves as the primary quality liaison between Elevate Aircraft Seating's manufacturing locations, Onsite Support Services (OSS), Boeing, and airline customers, ensuring effective communication, timely resolution of quality issues, and alignment with customer and regulatory requirements. This highly visible, customer-facing position is responsible for leading defect investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action coordination while driving quality improvements back into manufacturing operations to prevent recurring issues and strengthen product conformity. The Senior Manager of Customer Quality partners cross-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and customer stakeholders to drive accountability, proactively address quality concerns, and strengthen customer relationships. This position also provides executive leadership with data-driven reporting on quality performance, emerging risks, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives to support informed decision-making and operational excellence.

**SUMMARY OF JOB DUTIES** - **Essential Functions****(Other duties and projects may be assigned or requested.)**

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential*

**Customer Quality Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary quality liaison between Elevate manufacturing locations, Onsite Support Services (OSS), Boeing, and airline customers, ensuring alignment on quality concerns, operational priorities, and resolution activities.
* Lead customer-facing quality discussions, providing technically accurate information, objective evidence, and clear communication regarding product conformity, nonconformances, and corrective actions.
* Establish and maintain structured communication cadences with internal and external stakeholders to ensure timely escalation, consistent messaging, and accountability for quality-related issues.
* Build and maintain strong customer relationships through proactive engagement, effective problem-solving, and timely resolution of quality concerns.

**Defect Management & Technical Quality Assurance**

* Lead the investigation, documentation, and resolution of product defects and nonconformances, identifying root causes, points of origin, and appropriate corrective actions across manufacturing, receiving inspection, and final assembly operations.
* Evaluate reported nonconformances against applicable Letters of Conformance (LOCs), approved craftsmanship documentation, engineering specifications, and customer requirements to ensure accurate defect classification and resolution.
* Partner with Boeing and internal Quality and Engineering teams on corrective action investigations, providing technical analysis, objective evidence, and recommendations to support effective resolution.
* Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of aircraft interior products, functionality, design requirements, and installation processes to effectively evaluate quality concerns and communicate technical findings.
* Coordinate appropriate inspection and acceptance testing support during aircraft installation activities, including verification of electrical connections, mechanical functionality, and applicable acceptance test procedures (ATP).

**Quality Management Systems & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure customer-facing quality activities align with applicable FAA/EASA regulations, AS9100 standards, customer specifications, and internal Quality Management System (QMS) requirements.
* Maintain accurate, traceable quality documentation and defect records through established systems, including SharePoint, ensuring appropriate stakeholders have access to current information and supporting evidence.
* Coordinate the communication and implementation of applicable service bulletins, engineering changes, and product effectivity requirements across manufacturing locations, OSS, Boeing, and customers.
* Support customer quality reviews, audits, and regulatory compliance activities by providing technical documentation, investigation findings, and corrective action evidence.
